notes.title: Damaged In Transit is now on the Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35599260/8595bc7537a90350e97377b932360db4356cfc86.gif

Embrace the miracle of automated delivery on the Nintendo Switch!
We're excited to provide you with more ways to enjoy Damaged In Transit. A great platform to play it on commutes, beds or the TV. And amazing for Co-op.

Go get it here!
https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/damaged-in-transit-switch/
